phenomena.claim: No distinctive quantum-gravity phenomenon has been observed; spacetime below tested scales is not directly observed

phenomena.claim: Planck-scale-sensitive null results exist and bound generic modifications: gravitational-wave speed equals light speed to between -3e-15 and +7e-16 (GW170817/GRB 170817A); linear Planck-suppressed photon dispersion requires a quantum-gravity mass scale above the Planck mass (GRB 090510)

Lett. 848, L13 (2017), arXiv:1710.05834; Fermi GBM/LAT Collaborations, Nature 462, 331-334 (2009), arXiv:0908.1832 -- both abstract-verified 2026-09-23; archive: RAI_STRUCTURAL_THEORY_SEARCH Answer 1 evidence ledger ('exactly two TT polarizations at c to 10^-15')
phenomena.caveat: these constrain dispersive/LIV-type modifications generically; they do not test any audited approach's core claim

formalism.claim: Causal set theory: spacetime as a locally finite partially ordered set, kinematics from causal order plus counting (order + number)
formalism.source: Bombelli, Lee, Meyer & Sorkin, Phys. Rev. Lett. 59, 521 (1987) -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
formalism.caveat: kinematics established; quantum dynamics (a satisfactory sum-over-causal-sets) remains open

formalism.claim: Causal dynamical triangulations: nonperturbative lattice regularization of the Lorentzian gravitational path integral over causally layered triangulations, with an emergent de Sitter-like background phase
formalism.source: Ambjorn, Gorlich, Jurkiewicz & Loll, Phys. Rev. Lett. 100, 091304 (2008), arXiv:0712.2485 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
formalism.caveat: archive hostile demotion of the emergent-de-Sitter exhibit recorded (RAI_GORILLA_T1 XVI-I): pole designation = supplied orientation; reconstructed slices; unestimated systematics

formalism.claim: Algebraic QFT: Haag-Kastler net of local observable algebras; under standard assumptions the local algebras of any reasonable Poincare-covariant QFT are isomorphic to the unique hyperfinite type III_1 factor
formalism.source: Buchholz, D'Antoni & Fredenhagen, Commun. Math. Phys. 111, 123-135 (1987) -- record verified via Semantic Scholar/publisher listing 2026-09-23
formalism.caveat: universality result; conditional on the paper's stated assumptions (nuclearity-type conditions)

primitives.claim: CDT's causal layering (the inserted global foliation) is a primitive of the construction, not derived
primitives.source: definition of the CDT ensemble: Ambjorn, Jurkiewicz & Loll, Nucl. Phys. B 610, 347-382 (2001), arXiv:hep-th/0105267 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23, verifier pass (sliced transfer-matrix construction; the word 'foliation' is the community gloss, cf. causally layered triangulations in PRL 100, 091304); archive: RAI_GORILLA_T1 XVI-I 'CDT can host [the selection question] and answers with an inserted foliation'
primitives.caveat: archive grade kept: in 2D the inserted foliation provably survives to the continuum as physics (Horava-Lifshitz; see known_connections); its 4D continuum fate is open

primitives.claim: In AQFT the net assignment (which algebra belongs to which region) is the first primitive; modular theory cannot host the question of why that assignment -- the explanandum is its own starting point, and granting it, all local algebras are isomorphic, so the physical content lives in the net, not the single algebra
primitives.source: archive: RAI_GORILLA_T1 XVI-I G-WEAK record ('modular theory cannot host the question... the true target is the net')
primitives.caveat: archive grade kept: G-WEAK is 'non-trivial but unprotected' -- its content lives in a typing decision ('does demanding k-locality count as a supplied selection?') frozen nowhere; in-house, unreviewed

derived_objects.claim: CDT spectral dimension runs from ~4 at large scales to ~2 near the Planck scale (dynamical dimensional reduction)
derived_objects.source: Ambjorn, Jurkiewicz & Loll, Phys. Rev. Lett. 95, 171301 (2005), arXiv:hep-th/0505113 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
derived_objects.caveat: numerical (Monte Carlo) result within the CDT ensemble

derived_objects.claim: Crossed-product construction: gravitationally dressed observables convert type III_1 subregion algebras to type II, where generalized entropy S_gen = A/4G + S_out is obtained as a von Neumann entropy with zero fitted parameters
derived_objects.source: Kudler-Flam, Leutheusser & Satishchandran, Phys. Rev. D 111, 025013 (2025), arXiv:2309.15897; region-general and gravity-independent version: Ali Ahmad & Jefferson, SciPost Phys. Core 7, 020 (2024), arXiv:2306.07323 -- both abstract-verified 2026-09-23
derived_objects.caveat: archive assessment kept (RAI_STRUCTURAL_THEORY_SEARCH Answer 2): the one programme that 'derived a genuinely new structural consequence from standard premises'; empirical status EMPIRICALLY-INACCESSIBLE

derived_objects.claim: The Sorkin-Johnston state: a distinguished vacuum constructed from the spacetime (or causal set) geometry alone, without a mode choice
derived_objects.source: Surya, Nomaan X & Yazdi, JHEP 07 (2019) 009, arXiv:1812.10228 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
derived_objects.caveat: 'distinguished' is construction-relative: a frequency-sign selection enters (archive XVI-I residual-input list); discrete-vs-continuum tension recorded in the source itself

constants.claim: Planck length l_P = sqrt(hbar G / c^3) = 1.616255(18)e-35 m -- the common scale at which every audited approach locates new structure; a derived combination of measured constants, not an independently measured quantity

constants.caveat: uncertainty is inherited entirely from G; no observation ties any measured phenomenon to this scale

symmetries.claim: Causal-set discreteness is compatible with exact Lorentz invariance: there exists no equivariant measurable map from Poisson sprinklings to spacetime directions, so a sprinkled causal set picks out no preferred frame
symmetries.source: Bombelli, Henson & Sorkin, Mod. Phys. Lett. A 24, 2579-2587 (2009), arXiv:gr-qc/0605006 -- abstract-verified 2026-09-23
symmetries.caveat: theorem is about intrinsically defined structures on sprinklings; it does not by itself fix the phenomenology of causal-set dynamics

limits.claim: No boundary-free background-independent programme has reached matter coupling together with an established continuum limit

known_connections.claim: 2D CDT is 2D projectable Horava-Lifshitz quantum gravity: the continuum Hamiltonian of analytically solved 2D CDT is the quantization of 2D projectable Horava-Lifshitz gravity -- the inserted foliation survives to the continuum as physics in 2D
